_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 3: Optomon ($93FA-$952D). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): first frame?
regions.description: TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): bit 7 set goes to `$9438`. Stats: hit points 10, 16, 20 (x 16 once widened), attack 48, 64, 96, collision flags `$5A`, drawing flags 0, art block `$40`, dies as type 7. Score 10,000 each.

regions.description: Drawn only on frames where `$0788` is even (`$944A`), otherwise nothing.

regions.description: `JSR $C09F` with A = `$12` (the x spring toward `$0680`, 18/256 a frame) and `JSR $C09C` with A = `$20` (the y spring toward `$0668`, 32/256). RUN: x swung between 12 and 244, y bobbed between 43 and 52, for all three types.

regions.name: TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): when the beam timer counts
regions.description: The timer only runs in the animation phases whose tile offset (`$951A[phase]`) is under `$28`; in the others it goes straight to the picture.

regions.name: TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): the beam timer
regions.description: `$07A0` is decremented; non-zero skips to the aimed shot.

regions.name: TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): reload, and the beam's speed
regions.description: The timer := `$9478[type]` (`$9525`: `$28`, `$20`, `$44`, in the phases that count); the beam's y speed byte `$947B[type]` (`$9528`: 1, 0, 1).

regions.name: TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): a random speed (type `$2E`)
regions.description: A table byte of 0 means random: `($F9D1 AND 3) OR 1`, i.e. 1 or 3. RUN: type `$2E` made beams of speed 1 and 3; the others always 1.

regions.name: TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): keep the speed
TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): toward the player
regions.description: If the boss is below the player (its y is not under `$0518` of slot 0) the speed is negated: **the beam always travels toward the player's row**. RUN: from y 48 to a player at y 150 the beams moved down (+1, +3).

regions.name: TYPES $2D / $2E / $2F (OPTOMON, corridor bosses 11, 3 and 16; bank 3 slot `$8012`, reached from bank 6 `$907A`): the beam's style
regions.description: `$14` := `$947E[type]` (`$952B`: 9, 12, 15): the `$FE22` record `(metasprite 0, $0638 = $20 / $40 / $60, half-width 2)`: a thin beam, longer for the later types.
